items.title: Gokul hikes buffalo milk price by ₹6, cow milk by ₹4; farmers unhappy
items.rss_summary: The Kolhapur District Cooperative Milk Producers' Union, popularly known as Gokul Milk Union, has decided to increase the selling price of buffalo milk by Rs 6 per litre and cow milk by Rs 4 per litre with immediate effect, its chairman Rajesh Patil said on Saturday. The decision was taken unanimously by all 25 directors due to the drought situation and the difficulties faced by farmers, Patil, a former MLA, said. The union has also decided to raise the procurement rates paid to milk producers by Rs 3 per litre for buffalo milk and Rs 2 per litre for cow milk, he said, adding that this hike was "historic". "The revised rates will come into effect from November 21 and remain applicable for around 131 days, till March. The situation will be reviewed every month, and the board will take further decisions depending on the circumstances," Patil said. items.title: Hero FinCorp aims to double loan disbursements over next two quarters
items.rss_summary: Hero FinCorp aims to double its loan disbursement volumes over the next two quarters, after disbursing over 4.80 lakh loans across northern India between January and September this year. Financial services company Hero FinCorp Ltd is a division of two-wheeler manufacturer Hero MotoCorp. The company's growth plans will be supported by its diversified lending portfolio, distribution network and artificial intelligence-led underwriting capabilities, according to a statement. The non-banking financial company caters to diverse financing needs through a comprehensive portfolio of retail, MSME and corporate lending solutions. "Over 4.8 lakh households and businesses across seven states have chosen us this year for a two-wheeler, a car, a personal loan, working capital or a loan against property. "We aim to double our growth in the region over the next two quarters while keeping the customer's trust at the centre of every decision we make," Hero FinCorp's spokesperson said.

items.title: Ashok Leyland to set up truck plant in Singur, work to begin soon: Minister

Speaking to reporters after Prime Minister Narendra Modi's programme at IIT Kharagpur, Majumdar said the BJP government was committed to bringing industry to Singur and that the proposed facility would manufacture heavy vehicles. "We want to bring industry back to Singur. Our chief minister has also said so. I am reiterating today that Ashok Leyland is coming to Singur. It will set up a truck manufacturing plant, and work will begin soon," the Union minister of state for education said. items.title: GST Network adds metro rail as fifth mode of transport in e-way bill system
items.rss_summary: The GST Network (GSTN) has added metro rail as a new mode of transport in the e-way bill system. Currently, the facility has also been released in the "Sandbox environment" for API users to test and make necessary changes to their systems. Its roll-out in the live API environment will be announced separately, GSTN, which manages the IT backbone of Goods and Services Tax, said. The facility follows a government notification dated October 26. With this addition, the e-way bill system now has five modes of transport: Road, Rail, Air, Ship and Metro Rail. Under the Goods and Services Tax (GST), the e-way bill is mandatory for transiting goods valued at Rs 50,000 and above, both inter- and intra-state. GSTN, in an advisory issued on November 20, said the new option is available to web users for generating e-way bills and updating transport details. items.title: Adani Energy to supply 2,500 MW renewable energy to West Bengal discom
items.rss_summary: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd (AESL) on Saturday said its wholly-owned subsidiary Powerpulse Trading Solutions Ltd (PTSL) has bagged a project to supply up to 2,500 MW of renewable energy to West Bengal discom WBSEDCL for 25 years. The Letter of Award (LoA) from West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Co Ltd (WBSEDCL) is for the supply of 1,750 MW of renewable energy round-the-clock for a period of 25 years. The LoA provides a 750 MW green shoe option, which, upon exercise, would take the aggregate contracted capacity to 2,500 MW, AESL said in a statement. The award follows a competitive bidding process. items.title: Industry body GJC alerts BIS over gold adulteration using Rhenium, Iridium
items.rss_summary: The All India Gem and Jewellery Domestic Council (GJC) on Friday said it alerted the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) about reports of the alleged use of Rhenium- and Iridium-based alloys to increase gold's weight, and urged the industry and consumers to remain vigilant. "While there have been media reports from certain quarters regarding the possible misuse of materials such as Rhenium and Iridium in gold, we want to assure the entire jewellery industry and all gold buyers that there is absolutely no reason to panic. The Bureau of Indian Standards is treating the matter with utmost seriousness," GJC Chairman Rajesh Rokde said in a statement. According to media reports, Rhenium- and Iridium-based alloys were allegedly used to increase gold's weight without a corresponding increase in purity. items.hinglish_title: Sone Me Milawat Ko Lekar GJC Ne BIS Ko Kiya Alert

Is tarike se sone ki purity badhaye bina sirf uska wazan badhane ka arop hai. GJC ne industry aur buyers ko satark rehne aur kisi bhi shaqi mamle ki complaint darj karne ko kaha hai.
